edition.authority: Sacred Congregation of Rites, decree of 25 July 1920 declaring the Vatican edition typical; approval leaf of Francis Joseph, Archbishop of New York, given 8 December 1942, reciting conformity to the typical edition and to the decree of the Sacred Congregation of Rites of 9 January 1942
edition.publication: Missale Romanum ex decreto Sacrosancti Concilii Tridentini restitutum, S. Pii V Pontificis Maximi iussu editum, aliorum Pontificum cura recognitum, a Pio X reformatum, Benedicti XV auctoritate vulgatum; editio IV iuxta typicam Vaticanam. New York: Benziger Brothers, Inc., Summi Pontificis et Sacrae Rituum Congregationis typographorum. Copyright 1942 and 1944. Internet Archive item missale-romanum-1947.
edition.title: Missale Romanum, editio IV iuxta typicam Vaticanam (Benziger Brothers), pre-1955 witness of unestablished printing year

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The Roman Rite altar book containing the Order of Mass, the temporal and sanctoral cycles, Commons, votive and Requiem Masses, and related rubrical and ritual material. Edition records distinguish the authoritative typical edition from publisher-produced editions made according to it.
work.title: Missale Romanum
